name: UBoT Holding Ltd.
summary: UBoT Holding Ltd. is an investment holding firm owned by Sino Success Ventures Limited, set up in 2005 and based in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong. It develops, makes and sells back-end semiconductor transport media such as trays and carrier tapes, and MEMS and sensor packaging. Customers include fabless-foundry companies, device manufacturers and packaging and test firms across Asia, the United States and Europe.
